title: Three killed in suspected shootout in US city of Seattle, police say
english: A violent shootout at the Bite of Seattle food festival has left three people dead and four others injured, including a young child. Police have taken one teenage suspect into custody, while a second individual involved in the incident remains at large. Local officials expressed deep concern regarding the increasing trend of gun violence in the city following this tragedy.
amharic: በሲያትል በተካሄደው የምግብ ፌስቲቫል ላይ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ አንድ ህጻን እና ሶስት አዋቂዎችን ጨምሮ አራት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ፖሊስ ከአጥቂዎቹ አንዱን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን፣ ሁለተኛው ተጠርጣሪ ግን አሁንም በነጻነት ላይ ይገኛል። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር በከተማዋ እየተባባሰ በመጣው የሽጉጥ ጥቃት የተሰማቸውን ጥልቅ ሀዘን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ayyaana nyaataa Siyaatilii keessatti bakka namoonni baay'een jiranitti dhukaasa banameen namoonni saddeef du'anii, ijoollee xixiqqoo dabalatee namoonni afur ammoo madaa'aniiru. Poolisiin shakkamaa tokko to'annoo jala oolchuu kan danda'e yoo ta'u, shakkamaan lammaffaan garuu amma iyyuu bakka jiru hin beekamu. Hojjettoonni mootummaa magaalattii rakkoo dhukaasaa magaalicha keessatti dabalaa dhufe kanaaf gadda guddaa kan ibsan yoo ta'u, qorannoon itti fufee akka jiru himaniiru.

title: Houthis launch drone attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure
english: The Houthi group, backed by Iran, claimed responsibility for a drone strike targeting Saudi Arabian oil infrastructure on Monday. While the Houthis stated they successfully hit sensitive supply facilities, Saudi authorities have not yet confirmed any damage or injuries. Meanwhile, the Saudi government reported intercepting separate drone attacks originating from Iraq and has urged Iraqi officials to stop such hostile activities.
amharic: በኢራን የሚደገፉት ሁቲዎች ሰኞ ዕለት በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የነዳጅ ማዕከላት ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ሁቲዎች በነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ ተቋማት ላይ ጉዳት ማድረሳቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ የሳዑዲ ባለሥልጣናት ስለደረሰው ጉዳት እስካሁን ያረጋገጡት ነገር የለም። በሌላ በኩል ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ከኢራቅ የተላኩ በርካታ ድሮኖችን መትታ መጣሏን በመግለጽ፣ ኢራቅ ድንበሯ ለጥቃት እንዳይውል ጥብቅ ማሳሰቢያ ሰጥታለች።
oromo: Humni Huthotaa kan Iran deeggaru, guyyaa Wiixataa kana buufataalee boba'aa Sa'udii irratti haleellaa xiyyaara maleeyyuu (drone) raawwachuu isaa beeksise. Huthotiin buufataalee gurguddoo irratti miidhaa geessisuu isaanii dubbatanis, mootummaan Sa'udii hanga ammaatti miidhaa geesse mirkaneessuu hin dandeenye. Gama biraatiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaan haleellaa xiyyaara maleeyyuu Iraq irraa ka'an mootummaa ishee akka dhaabsiisu gaafatteetti.

title: Israeli raids, demolitions continue across occupied West Bank
english: Israeli forces have intensified military operations across the West Bank, including a raid on a UN facility for Palestinian refugees in Qalandiya. During these incursions, troops used tear gas and stun grenades, leading to the detention of staff members and local residents. Similar raids and property demolitions were reported in multiple cities, including Nablus, Jenin, and Ramallah.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻውን አጠናክሮ የቀጠለ ሲሆን በቃላንድያ የሚገኘውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የስደተኞች ማዕከል ወረራ ፈጽሟል። በዚህ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት ወታደሮች የጥቃት ጋዝ በመጠቀም የተባበሩት መንግስታት ሰራተኞችን ጨምሮ በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በናብሉስ፣ በጀኒን እና በራማላህ ከተሞችም መሰል ወረራዎች እና የቤት ማፍረስ ተግባራት መፈጸማቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarxii dhiyaa (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa isaanii daran jabeessaniiru; keessattuu qubsuma Qalandiyaa keessatti bakka bu'oota gamtaa mootummootaatti weerara raawwataniiru. Tarkaanfii kanaan hojjettoota dhaabbatichaa fi jiraattota naannoo sanaa hedduu kan qaban yoo ta'u, gazii fi meeshaalee waraana kan biroos itti fayyadamaniiru. Magaalota akka Naablus, Jenin fi Ramallah keessattis weeraraa fi mancaatii manneenii raawwachuun gabaafameera.

title: Karim Khan dared to hold Israel to account - and that's why he was brought down
english: International Criminal Court Prosecutor Karim Khan has been dismissed following an intense 18-month campaign by Israel and its allies to stop him from pursuing arrest warrants against Israeli officials. Despite allegations of misconduct used to justify his removal, reports suggest these claims were politically motivated to discredit his legal actions regarding the situation in Palestine. This unprecedented pressure included direct intimidation, threats of sanctions from foreign governments, and a coordinated media effort to undermine his authority.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ዋና አቃቤ ህግ ከሪም ካን በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ላይ የእስር ማዘዣ በማውጣታቸው ከስልጣናቸው ተነስተዋል። የእስራኤል መንግስት እና አጋሮቹ ካንን ከስልጣን ለማውረድ ለ18 ወራት የዘለቀ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ እና የጫና ዘመቻ ሲያካሂዱ ቆይተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ካን በፍልስጤም ላይ እየተፈጸሙ ባሉ ወንጀሎች ምርመራ እንዲያቆሙ ለማስፈራራት እና ስማቸውን ለማጠልሸት የተደረገ የተቀናጀ ጥረት እንደሆነ ይነገራል።
oromo: Abbaan Alangaa Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa Karim Khaan, hoogganoota Israa'el irratti ajaja hidhaa baasuun isaanii hordofee aangoo irraa kaafamaniiru. Mootummaan Israa'el fi tumsuun ishee, Khaan hojii isaanii akka dhaaban dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi duula waggaa tokko fi walakkaa fudhate gaggeessaa turaniiru. Duulli kun himannaa seeraan ala ta'een kan walqabatu yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaa gurguddoon Khaan qorannoo Falasxiin irratti gaggeessaa turan akka dhaaban dirqisiisuu fi maqaa isaanii balleessuu dha.

title: Israel attacks civilians sheltering at UN school in Gaza, while separate strike kills two
english: Israeli forces launched an attack on Palestinian civilians gathered near a UN-run school in central Gaza, resulting in multiple injuries. In the past day, military strikes across the region have caused additional deaths and casualties, adding to the high toll of lives lost during ongoing violence. These recent events contribute to thousands of civilian fatalities and injuries since the conflict escalated late last year.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በማዕከላዊ ጋዛ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ትምህርት ቤት አካባቢ ተጠልለው የነበሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በተፈጸሙ የቦምብ ድብደባዎች ተጨማሪ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ማለፉና መቁሰላቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ግጭት ከጀመረ ወዲህ እጅግ ብዙ ሲቪሎች ለሞት እና ለጉዳት መዳረጋቸው ታውቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el ganda Deir el-Balah keessatti manneen barnoota UN biratti bakka qubatanii turan irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaafi kanneen biroo kanaan walqabatee namoonni hedduun miidhaniiru akkasumas lubbuun namoota dabalataas darbeera. Haleellaa gurguddaa erga kanaan dura turee as gaggeeffamaa jiruun namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman lubbuun darbuu fi qaama miidhamuu isaanii gabaasichi ibseera.

title: Tehran rejects seeking negotiations with US, confirms Hormuz remains closed
english: Iran's foreign ministry has officially denied seeking any new talks with the United States, labeling such negotiations contrary to their national principles. The country also confirmed that the Strait of Hormuz remains closed following discussions with Oman, emphasizing that these maritime issues are independent of American influence. Additionally, Tehran demanded that France stop interfering in its domestic matters after detaining two French diplomats for allegedly improper activities.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ከአሜሪካ ጋር አዲስ ድርድር የመጀመር ፍላጎት እንደሌለው በይፋ ገልጿል። ሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ከኦማን ጋር ከተደረገ ውይይት በኋላ እንደተዘጋ መሆኑን የገለጹት ቃል አቀባዩ፣ ይህ ውሳኔ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስረድተዋል። በተጨማሪም በኢራን የውስጥ ጉዳይ ጣልቃ በመግባት ላይ ናቸው ያሉዋቸውን ሁለት የፈረንሳይ ዲፕሎማቶች መያዙን ተከትሎ ፈረንሳይ ድርጊቷን እንድታቆም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan marii haaraa Ameerikaa waliin jalqabuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ifatti ibseera. Akkasumas, daandiin galaana Hormuz marii Omaan waliin taasifameen booda cufaa akka ta'e mirkaneessuun, murtoon kun dhiibbaa Ameerikaa irraa walaba ta'uu ibseera. Kana malees, Iraan dippiloomatoota Faransaay lama dhimma biyyattii keessa seenuuf yaalani jedhamu to'annoo jala oolchuun, mootummaan Faransaay gocha akkasii akka dhaabu akeekkachiisteerti.

title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
english: Global oil prices dropped significantly, falling below $88 per barrel, as both the United States and Iran suspended military strikes to allow for potential diplomatic discussions. This recent de-escalation offers hope for stabilizing energy markets after prices had spiked above $100 due to concerns over supply routes. However, experts remain cautious, noting that lasting peace is not guaranteed and that past failed ceasefires have contributed to ongoing market instability.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ወታደራዊ ግጭቶች መቆማቸውን ተከትሎ የዓለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ሁለቱ አገራት ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት ዕድል ለመስጠት ጥቃቶችን ማቆማቸው በገበያው ላይ እፎይታን የፈጠረ ሲሆን ዋጋውም ከአንድ በርሜል 100 ዶላር በታች ወርዷል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ለውጥ አዎንታዊ ቢሆንም፣ ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች በመፍረሳቸው ባለሙያዎች ለወደፊቱ ገበያ መረጋጋት ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አመለካከት አላቸው።
oromo: gatiin boba'aa addunyaa, walitti bu'iinsi waraanaa gidduu Ameerikaa fi Iraan dhaabbachuu isaatiin gadi bu'eera. Biyyoonni lamaan marii nagayaaf carraa kennuuf jechuun haleellaa waan dhaabaniif, gatiin boba'aa $100 irraa gara $88tti gadi bu'uu danda'eera. Haata'u malee, kanaan dura waliigalteen dhaabbii waraanaa irra deddeebi'amee waan diigameef, ogeeyyonni gabaan gara fuulduraatti akkam akka ta'u of eeggannoon hordofaa jiru.

title: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle
english: A shooting incident at a food festival near the Space Needle in Seattle resulted in three deaths and multiple injuries, including a young child. Authorities reported that two individuals were firing at each other, with one suspect currently in police custody while the other remains at large. Despite the ongoing investigation, officials have stated that there is no further risk to the community.
amharic: ሲያትል ውስጥ በሚገኘው ስፔስ ኒድል አቅራቢያ በተካሄደ የምግብ በዓል ላይ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ህጻን ልጅን ጨምሮ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ፖሊስ እንደገለጸው ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው እርስ በርስ በሚተኮሱ ሁለት ተጠርጣሪዎች መካከል ሲሆን፣ አንደኛው በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል ሌላኛው ግን አሁንም ፍለጋ ላይ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው አሁን ምንም አይነት የደህንነት ስጋት እንደሌለ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Siyaatilitti bakka 'Space Needle' jedhamutti ayyaana nyaataa irratti dhukaasa ka'een namoonni sadii du'anii hedduun madaa'aniiru; isaan madaa'an keessas daa'imni xinnoo tokko argama. Poolisoonni akka ibsanitti, dhukaasichi namoota lama gidduutti kan ka'e yoo ta'u, tokko to'annoo jala oolee kan biraa immoo barbaadamaa jira. Qorannoon kan itti fufu ta'us, mootummaan hawaasni sodaachuu akka hin qabne mirkaneesseera.

title: Pirlo out of Italy football top job after backlash over Russian betting firm links
english: Andrea Pirlo is no longer a candidate for the Italian national football coaching position following intense public criticism. Politicians opposed his potential appointment because of his professional ties to a Russian betting company that has been linked to the war in Ukraine. While Pirlo defended his partnership as strictly commercial and sporting, the backlash forced him to withdraw from contention.
amharic: ከሩሲያ የውርርድ ድርጅት ጋር ባለው ግንኙነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ትችት በመሰንዘሩ አንድሪያ ፒርሎ የጣሊያን ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ የመሆን ዕድሉ ተጠናቋል። ፖለቲከኞች ፒርሎ ከዩክሬን ጦርነት ጋር በተያያዘ ስሙ ከሚነሳ የሩሲያ ኩባንያ ጋር መሥራታቸውን በመቃወም አሰልጣኝ እንዳይሆኑ ተጽዕኖ አድርገዋል። ፒርሎ ግንኙነቱ ከስፖርት እና ንግድ ጋር ብቻ የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ ከከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ በኋላ ውድድሩን ለቋል።
oromo: Andrea Pirlo hariiroo inni dhaabbata gamoo (betting) Raashiyaa tokko waliin qabu irratti mormiin guddaan erga kaee booda, hojii leenjisummaa garee biyyaalessa Xaaliyaanii akka hin arganne ibsameera. Paartiileen siyaasaa, walitti dhufeenyi inni dhaabbata Raashiyaa waraana Yukreen wajjin walqabatu kana waliin qabu fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu dubbachuun isa balaaleffataniiru. Pirloon hojiin isaa kun dhimma daldalaa fi ispoortii qofa ta'uu ibsuuf yaalus, mormii guddaa isa mudateen booda carraa isaa dhiiseera.

title: Bali bans Dutch expats whose run club allegedly excluded Indonesians
english: Indonesian authorities have banned two Dutch citizens from re-entering the country after they organized a running event without the required permits. The organizers faced intense public criticism over accusations that their group, Entourage Bali, was excluding locals while favoring foreigners. While the club claimed the exclusion was a technical error, the incident has highlighted rising tensions between local residents and the growing expatriate community in Bali.
amharic: የኢንዶኔዥያ ባለሥልጣናት ያለምንም ህጋዊ ፈቃድ የማራቶን ዝግጅት ያዘጋጁ ሁለት የደች ዜጎችን ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዳይገቡ ከልክለዋል። አዘጋጆቹ ‘ኢንቱሬጅ ባሊ’ የተሰኘው ቡድናቸው የሀገር ውስጥ ነዋሪዎችን በማግለል የውጭ ዜጎችን ብቻ እንዲሳተፉ ማድረጉ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቶ ነበር። ምንም እንኳን አዘጋጆቹ መገለሉ በቴክኒክ ስህተት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ ክስተቱ በባሊ ነዋሪዎች እና በውጭ ሀገር ዜጎች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን አለመግባባት በይፋ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Indooneeshiyaa lammiilee Nezerlaandi lamaan hayyama malee sagantaa fiigichaa qindeessuu isaaniitiin biyyattii akka hin seenne dhorkeera. Gurmuun kun ‘Entourage Bali’ jedhamu, lammiilee biyyaattiin ala ta’an qofa qabachuu fi namoota biyya keessaa akka hin hirmaanne gochuu isaatiin mormii cimaa uumee ture. Gareen kun dhimmi kun dogoggora teeknikaa ta’uu isaa ibsuyyuu, rakkoon kun walitti buiinsa jiraattota naannichaa fi namoota biyya alaa gidduutti uumamee jiru bal’inaan ifa baaseera.

title: Sooryavanshi praised by Laxman after teen stars against Zimbabwe in T20
english: Indian teenage cricket talent Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was named player of the series after helping his team secure a 3-0 victory against Zimbabwe. Coach VVS Laxman praised the 15-year-old's impressive growth and maturity, noting his ability to bounce back from earlier struggles in England. While the coach highlighted the young player's eagerness and determination, he emphasized that continued improvements in physical fitness will be essential for his long-term success.
amharic: የህንድ ታዳጊ የክሪኬት ተጫዋች ቫይብሃቭ ሱርያቫንሺ በዚምባቡዌ ላይ በተደረገው ተከታታይ ጨዋታ ቡድኑ 3-0 እንዲያሸንፍ በማገዙ የውድድሩ ምርጥ ተጫዋች ተብሎ ተመርጧል። አሰልጣኝ ቪቪኤስ ላክስማን የ15 ዓመቱን ወጣት ብስለት እና ከእንግሊዝ ጉዞ በኋላ ያሳየውን የአቋም መሻሻል አድንቀዋል። አሰልጣኙ የተጫዋቹን ትጋት ያደነቁ ቢሆንም፣ በቀጣይ ለስኬታማነቱ የአካል ብቃቱን የበለጠ ማሻሻል እንደሚጠበቅበት ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Taphatni kirikeetii dargaggeessi Hindii Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, gareen isaa Zimbaabuwee irratti injifannoo 3-0 akka gonfatu gargaaruun taphattoota dorgommii kanaa hunda keessaa beekamtii argateera. Leenjisuun isaa VVS Laxman dargaggeessa umrii 15 kanaa guddinaa fi bilchina inni agarsiise akkasumas rakkoo kanaan dura Ingilaandiitti isa mudate mo'ee deebi'uu isaa dinqisiifateera. Leenjisuun kun fedhii fi murannoo taphatichaa kan jajaban yoo ta'u, milkaa'ina isaaf gara fuulduraatti cimina qaamaa isaa irratti hojjechuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibseera.

title: Photos: France, Spain battle ‘monster’ wildfires as more heat looms
english: France and Spain are currently struggling to contain massive wildfires that have displaced over 325,000 people. These intense fires have been fueled by extreme heatwaves and prolonged drought, with experts attributing the severity of the situation to climate change. As emergency services work to protect vulnerable areas, officials have warned that the threat remains high due to the expected arrival of even hotter temperatures.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ እና ስፔን ከ325,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው ያፈናቀሉ መጠነ ሰፊ የደን ቃጠሎዎችን ለመቆጣጠር እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ከፍተኛ የደን ቃጠሎዎች በከባድ የሙቀት ማዕበል እና በድርቅ ምክንያት የተከሰቱ ሲሆን፣ ባለሙያዎች ለዚህ አስከፊ ክስተት የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ዋና ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ድንገተኛ አደጋ ተቆጣጣሪዎች አካባቢውን ለመታደግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ በቀጣይ ቀናት የሚጠበቀው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ስጋቱን አባብሶታል።
oromo: Faransaayi fi Ispeen namoota 325,000 ol qe’ee isaanii irraa buqqise balaa ibidda bosonaa guddaa to’achuuf wal’aansoo gochaa jiru. Ibiddoonni kun ho’a qilleensaa cimaa fi hongeen kan babal’atan yoo ta’u, ogeeyyiin jijjiiramni qilleensaa sababa guddaa balaa kanaa ta’uu ibsu. Tajaajilli ariifachiisaan iddoowwan miidhaman oolchuuf tattaaffii godhuus, ho’i qilleensaa dabaluun isaa balaa kana caalatti hamaa akka godhuuf sodaatama.

title: Moment Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Belgorod
english: Ukrainian drones recently launched an attack on the Russian border city of Belgorod, causing significant damage. According to local officials, the strike left at least 12 individuals injured, including two young children. This incident highlights the ongoing escalation of the conflict between the two nations.
amharic: የዩክሬን ድሮኖች በሩሲያ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው በቤልጎሮድ ከተማ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ በጥቃቱ ሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የጦርነት ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni malee kan Yukreen magaalota daangaa Raashiyaa keessa jirtu Belgorod irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii akka ibsanitti, haleellaa kanaan yoo xiqqaate namoonni 12 kan miidhaman yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa ijoolleen lama ni argamu. Taateen kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran hammeenya agarsiisa.

title: Why has the US halted its bombing of Iran?
english: The United States has suspended its recent military strikes against Iran following a period of intense conflict. Reports suggest this pause may be due to a shortage of air defense supplies, though the government has officially denied this. Both nations have currently stopped their retaliatory attacks, leading to a slight drop in global oil prices and raising hopes for a diplomatic solution to the ongoing regional tension.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር የነበረው ከፍተኛ ግጭት ከተቀዘቀዘ በኋላ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ሲያደርስ የነበረውን የአየር ጥቃት አቁሟል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው አሜሪካ የመከላከያ የጦር መሳሪያዎች እጥረት ስላጋጠማት ሊሆን እንደሚችል የሚጠቁሙ ዘገባዎች ቢኖሩም መንግስት ይህንን አስተባብሏል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት በቀል የተሞላበት ጥቃታቸውን በመግታታቸው የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲቀንስ እና ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎች በር እንዲከፈት ተስፋ ተጥሏል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi cimaan erga uumamee booda, Amerikaan haleellaa airaa Iraan irratti gaggeessaa turte dhaabdeetti. Sababa haleellaa kana dhaabuu kanatti kan hidhataniis, Amerikaan meeshaalee waraanaa xiyyaaraa irratti itti fayyadaman dhabuu ishee kan ibsan gabaasonni ni jiru, ta'us mootummaan ishee oduu kana haaleera. Gareen lamaanuu haleellaa wal-irraa hirtu dhaabuu isaaniitiin, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa xiqqoo hir'ateera, akkasumas karaa dippilomaasii rakkoo kana furuuf abdii uumeera.

title: Israeli forces storm multiple West Bank towns, settler violence worsens
english: Israeli military forces have launched a widespread offensive across the occupied West Bank, conducting raids in at least 20 towns and villages. During these operations, soldiers have demolished homes, detained dozens of Palestinians, and allegedly obstructed emergency medical care, resulting in severe consequences. Concurrently, Jewish settlers have increased their violent attacks on Palestinian homes and farms, while authorities continue to focus arrests on Palestinians rather than addressing settler aggression.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ በቢያንስ 20 ከተሞችና መንደሮች ላይ ሰፊ ወረራ አካሂደዋል። በዚህ ዘመቻ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ ቤቶችን በማፍረስና በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንን በማሰር ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ አምቡላንሶችን በማገታቸውም ከባድ የጤና ቀውሶች እየተፈጠሩ ነው። በአንጻሩ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በፈረንጆች የሚፈጽሙት ጥቃት እየተባባሰ ቢመጣም፣ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰፋሪዎችን ከመቆጣጠር ይልቅ በፈረንጆቹ ላይ እስሮችን በማብዛት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa jiru (West Bank) keessatti magaalota fi gandaa 20 ol ta'an irratti duula bal'aa gaggeessaa jiru. Duula kanaan mana jireenyaa diiganii fi namoota hedduu hidhaatti darbaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, namoota gargaarsa ariifataa barbaadan karaatti gufuu ta'uun isaanii balaa hamaa geessiseera. Gammachuu biroo kanaan, qubattoonni Israa'el qabeenyaa fi mana warra Falasxiin irratti haleellaa raawwatan kan dabale yoo ta'u, humnoonni naga eegsisootaa garuu qubattoota kana to'achuu mannaa, namoota Falasxiin irratti tarkaanfii hidhaa fudhachuu filataniiru.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopian politics is undergoing a major shift as proposed constitutional reforms move away from the traditional central influence of Amhara political thought. The transition from the old coalition-based power structure to the Prosperity Party's system of demographic majoritarianism means that political power is now tied more to regional population size. As a result, Amhara political groups face the significant challenge of adjusting to a peripheral role in the nation's changing governance structure.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ፖለቲካ በአዲስ የሕገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ ሀሳቦች ሳቢያ ትልቅ ለውጥ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የአማራ ፖለቲካዊ አስተሳሰብ ከነበረው የማዕከላዊ ተፅእኖ እንዲርቅ እያደረገው ነው። ቀደም ሲል የነበረው የጥምረት የሥልጣን አወቃቀር ወደ ብልፅግና ፓርቲ የቁጥር የበላይነት ሥርዓት በመሸጋገሩ፣ የፖለቲካ ሥልጣን በቀጥታ ከክልሎች የህዝብ ብዛት ጋር ተያይዟል። በዚህም ምክንያት የአማራ የፖለቲካ ኃይሎች በሀገሪቱ እየተቀየረ ባለው የመንግስት አስተዳደር ውስጥ ያላቸውን ሚና እንደገና የመገምገም ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Siyaasni Itiyoophiyaa jijjiirama guddaa keessa jiraachuun, caasaan mootummaa fi mootummaan biyyattii akka kanaan duraa bu’uura Amhara irratti kan hin hundoofne ta’uu isaa ibsa. Mootummaan badhaadhinaa sirna itti fayyadama lakkoofsa ummataa irratti hundaa’uun aangootti fayyadamuun, dhiibbaa siyaasaa kanaan dura ture jijjiireera. Jijjiiramni kun humnoota siyaasaa Amharaaf gahee siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti qaban haala haaraan akka madaalan isaan dirqisiiseera.

title: 'This is just the start': India's Gen Z protesters force out a minister, but what next?
english: In a rare political shift, Indian youth protesters successfully pressured Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan to resign following widespread anger over a major medical exam scandal. The movement gained momentum through viral social media campaigns that bypassed mainstream media control, highlighting a new wave of digital-native activism. While this resignation marks a significant win for the younger generation, activists are now focused on pushing for broader education reforms and justice for affected families.
amharic: በህንድ በአንድ የህክምና መግቢያ ፈተና ላይ በተፈጠረ የጥያቄ ወረቀት መፍሰስ ሳቢያ በተቀሰቀሰ ተቃውሞ፣ የሀገሪቱ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር ධርሜንድራ ፕራዳን ከስልጣናቸው እንዲለቁ ተገደዋል። ወጣቶች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመጠቀም ያደራጁት ይህ የተቃውሞ ንቅናቄ፣ በመንግስት ላይ ለውጥ ማምጣት እንደሚቻል ያሳየ ትልቅ ድል ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ አሁን ትኩረታቸውን በትምህርት ስርዓቱ ላይ ለውጥ ለማምጣት እና ጉዳት ለደረሰባቸው ቤተሰቦች ፍትህ ለማግኘት ላይ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti qorumsa seensaa fayyaa irratti rakkoo hatamuu gaaffiiwwanii hordofee, barattoonniifi dargaggoonni mormii guddaa gaggeessaniin Ministirri Barnootaa Dharmendiraa Piraadaan aangoo gadi akka lakkisan dirqisiisaniiru. Dargaggoonni kun miidiyaa hawaasaatti fayyadamuu dhaan mormii kana bakka bu’iinsa guddaa irraan ga’aniiru, kunis humna dargaggoonni jijjiirama fiduuf qaban kan agarsiise ta’eera. Amma garuu, mormitoonni kun fedhiin isaanii inni guddaan sirna barnootaa fooyyessuufi maatii miidhaan irra ga’eef haqaa argamsiisuu dha.

title: Rapper Yung Filly tells trial 'vibes were good' with woman who accuses him of rape
english: British rapper Yung Filly, whose real name is Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos, is currently on trial in Australia facing multiple charges of sexual assault and violence. During his testimony, the performer denied the accusations and claimed that his interaction with the accuser was consensual and positive. The trial continues as the court examines the events that took place in his hotel room following a concert performance last year.
amharic: አንድሬስ ፌሊፔ ቫለንሲያ ባሪየንቶስ በመባል የሚታወቀው የብሪታኒያው ራፐር ያንግ ፊሊ በአውስትራሊያ የጾታ ጥቃት እና የጉዳት ክሶች ቀርበውበት ክርክር እያደረገ ነው። ራፐሩ በችሎት ፊት ባቀረበው ምስክርነት ክሱ የፈጠራ ወሬ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ከተከሰሰችው ሴት ጋር የነበረው ግንኙነት በስምምነት ላይ የተመሠረተ እንደነበር ተናግሯል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ካለፈው ዓመት ኮንሰርት በኋላ በሆቴል ክፍል ውስጥ የተፈጠረውን ክስተት በማጣራት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Raapperiin biyya Ingilizii Yung Filly jedhamu, maqaan isaa dhugaan Andres Felipe Valencia Barrientos, Awustiraaliyaatti himata gudeeddii fi miidhaa qaamaa irratti dhiyaatee falmaa jira. Abbaa alangaa fi mana murtiitti akka ibsetti, namichi himata irratti dhiyaate kana waakkachuun, waliigaltee waliin akka qabaatan ibseera. Mana murtichi guyyaa har'aa waayee gareen kun hootela keessatti wal argatan irratti ragaa fi falmii dhaggeeffachuu itti fufeera.

title: Argentinian leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'
english: Argentinian President Javier Milei recently insulted Brazil's leader, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, by labeling him a thief and a convict during a political rally in Sao Paulo. In response to these remarks made while supporting a right-wing candidate, the Brazilian government decided to recall its ambassador from Buenos Aires. President Lula rejected the interference, emphasizing that Brazil maintains its own sovereignty despite these diplomatic tensions.
amharic: የአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዚዳንት ሃቪየር ሚሌይ በሳኦ ፓውሎ በተደረገ የፖለቲካ ስብሰባ ላይ የብራዚሉን መሪ ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫን ሌባ እና ወንጀለኛ በማለት ተችተዋል። ይህንን ተከትሎ የብራዚል መንግስት በአርጀንቲና የሚገኘውን አምባሳደሩን ወደ ሀገሩ እንዲመለስ አድርጓል። ፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ በበኩላቸው የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነትን እንደማይቀበሉ በመግለጽ የአገራቸውን ሉዓላዊነት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Arjentiinaa Javier Milei magaalaa Saawoo Paawuloo keessatti walgahii siyaasaa irratti pirezedantii Biroozil Luwii Iinaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa irratti yakka cimaa fayyadamuun 'hattuu' fi 'hidhamaa' jechuun arrabsaniiru. Gocha kana hordofee mootummaan Biroozil ambaasaaddara isaanii Arjentiinaa jiru gara biyyaatti akka deebi'u ajajeera. Pirezedantni Luulaa gama isaaniin, biyyi isaanii qaama alaa kamiyyuu akka hin seene himuun, kabajaa fi bilisummaa biyya isaanii akka eeggatan ibsaniiru.

title: The AI military complex: Which are the main companies in it?
english: Military strategies are shifting from traditional hardware to advanced software, as global governments invest billions into artificial intelligence for modern warfare. Major technology companies are now securing massive contracts to provide autonomous drones, data processing tools, and decision-making software for defense agencies. This transformation marks a new era where battles are increasingly fought through screens and sophisticated digital platforms.
amharic: የዓለም መንግስታት በዘመናዊ ጦርነት ውስጥ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI) ለመጠቀም በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዶላር ኢንቨስት እያደረጉ በመሆኑ፣ ወታደራዊ ስልቶች ከባህላዊ መሳሪያዎች ወደ ዘመናዊ ሶፍትዌሮች እየተቀየሩ ነው። ዋና ዋና የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖችን፣ የመረጃ ማቀነባበሪያ መሳሪያዎችን እና ወሳኝ ውሳኔዎችን የሚወስኑ ሶፍትዌሮችን ለጦር ሰራዊት ለማቅረብ ትላልቅ ውሎችን እየተፈራረሙ ነው። ይህ ለውጥ ጦርነቶች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ በስክሪን እና በተራቀቁ ዲጂታል መድረኮች የሚካሄዱበትን አዲስ ምዕራፍ እያመጣ ነው።
oromo: Mootummoonni addunyaa waraana ammayyeessuuf teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' irratti biliyoonaan lakkaawwamu baasii gochaa waan jiraniif, tarsiimoon waraanaa meeshaalee aadaarraa gara sooftiweerii fooyya'aatti jijjiiramaa jira. Kompaniileen teeknoolojii gurguddoonis dooniiwwan ofiin balali'an, meeshaalee odeeffannoo qindeessan fi sooftiweerii murtoo kennan waraanaaf dhiheessuuf waligaltee gurguddaa mallatteessaa jiru. Jijjiiramni kun waraanni gara fuulduraatti bal'inaan iskiiriinii fi meeshaalee dijitaalaan kan gaggeeffamu ta'uusaa agarsiisa.

title: Tadej Pogacar wins Tour de France for a record-equalling fifth time
english: Tadej Pogacar has secured his fifth Tour de France title, matching the legendary record held by four other cyclists. The Slovenian rider achieved this victory by winning three consecutive races and dominating the competition throughout the event. While Mathieu van der Poel won the final stage in Paris, Pogacar’s overall performance solidified his status as the best cyclist in the world today.
amharic: ታዴጅ ፖጋቻር በአምስት የቱር ደ ፍራንስ ድሎች ሌሎች አራት አፈ ታሪክ የብስክሌት ስፖርተኞችን በመቀላቀል ታሪካዊ ውጤት አስመዝግቧል። የስሎቬኒያው ተወዳዳሪ ይህንን ድል የተቀዳጀው ተከታታይ ሶስት ውድድሮችን በማሸነፍ ሲሆን በውድድሩ በሙሉ ብልጫውን አሳይቷል። ማቲዩ ቫን ደር ፖል የመጨረሻውን የፓሪስ ምዕራፍ ቢያሸንፍም፣ ፖጋቻር በአጠቃላይ ውጤቱ የዘንድሮውን የውድድር ዘመን አሸናፊ በመሆን አቅሙን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: ታዴጅ ፖጋቻር ውድድር የቱር ደ ፍራንስን ለኢንቲን ጊዜ በማሸነፍ የቀድሞ ሪከርድ የያዙ አራት ታዋቂ ብስክሌተኞችን እኩል ሆኗል። የሰሎቬንያው ተወዳዳሪ ይህንን ድል የተጎናጸፈው ሶስት ተከታታይ ውድድሮችን በማሸነፍ እና በውድድሩ ሁሉ ብልጫ በማሳየት ነው። ማቲዩ ቫን ደር ፖል የመጨረሻውን የፓሪስ ምዕራፍ ቢያሸንፍም፣ ፖጋቻር በጠቅላላ ውጤት አንደኛ በመውጣት የአሁኑ የዓለም ምርጥ የብስክሌት ተወዳዳሪ መሆኑን አሳይቷል።

title: German arms export licences for Israel surge with focus on sub project
english: Germany has significantly increased its military export approvals to Israel, authorizing nearly 800 million euros in weapons during the first five months of 2026. The majority of this funding is directed toward a major maritime project, widely believed to be the delivery of a new, nuclear-capable submarine built by TKMS. This surge in support comes despite official German concerns regarding the ongoing military conflict in Gaza.
amharic: ጀርመን እ.ኤ.አ. በ2026 በመጀመሪያዎቹ አምስት ወራት ውስጥ ወደ እስራኤል የምታደርገውን የወታደራዊ መሳሪያ ላኪነት ፍቃድ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ጨምራለች። አብዛኛው የዚህ ፈቃድ ድጋፍ በባህር ኃይል ፕሮጀክት ላይ ያተኮረ ሲሆን ይህም በቲኬኤምኤስ (TKMS) የተሰራው የኒውክሌር መያዝ አቅም ያለው የሰርጓጅ መርከብ ግዥ እንደሆነ ይገመታል። ይህ የጀርመን ድጋፍ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ካለው ጦርነት ጋር ተያይዞ በበርሊን በኩል ስጋት ቢኖርም የተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Jarmanii ji'oota shanan jalqaba bara 2026 keessatti, meeshaalee waraanaa gara Israa'elitti ergamuuf hayyama baay'ee guddaa ta'e kenniteetti. Hayyamni kun kaffaltii Euro miliyoona 800 ol kan qabu yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa baay'een isaa hojii gamoo galaanaa irratti kan ooluu fi markaba duubee (submarine) nukilera fe'uu danda'u kan TKMS oomishe bituuf kan oolu akka ta'e dubbatama. Gargaarsi kun guddachuu kan danda'e, mootummaan Jarmanii waraana Gaaza keessatti adeemaa jiruuf yaaddoo qabaachuu ishee ibsitu illee, Israa'eliif deggarsa waraanaa kennuu hin dhaabin.

title: Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike
english: Iran has threatened retaliation against Ukraine following a deadly strike on an Iranian commercial ship in the Caspian Sea that resulted in casualties. Iranian officials condemned the attack as a violation of international law and accused Israel of inciting the incident to expand the regional conflict. While Ukraine claims the vessel was involved in transporting military cargo, Iran denies any involvement in the Russia-Ukraine war and has summoned a Ukrainian diplomat to protest the action.

title: Climate change presents new threat to Philippines’ UNESCO rice terraces
english: The historic Ifugao rice terraces in the Philippines, a UNESCO World Heritage site, are facing severe destruction from increasingly frequent and intense extreme weather events. Landslides caused by recent typhoons have already damaged critical irrigation systems and farmlands, threatening the traditional livelihoods of local farmers. Limited government support makes it difficult for the community to protect this ancient cultural landmark against the growing impacts of climate change.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ የሚገኙትና የዩኔስኮ የዓለም ቅርስ የሆኑት የኢፉጋዎ የሩዝ እርከኖች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየተባባሰ በመጣው አስከፊ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ላይ ወድቀዋል። በቅርቡ በተከሰቱ ኃይለኛ አውሎ ነፋሶች ምክንያት የተፈጠሩ የመሬት መንሸራተቶች የውኃ ማስተላለፊያ መስመሮችን እና የእርሻ መሬቶችን በማውደማቸው የአካባቢውን ገበሬዎች ኑሮ አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል። መንግስት በቂ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ እየተቸገረ በመሆኑ፣ ይህ ጥንታዊ የባህል መዳረሻ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት ለሚደርስበት ጉዳት ተጋላጭ ሆኗል።
oromo: Dirreen midhaan ruuzii Ifugao kan Filippiinis, kan UNESCO biratti akka dhaabbata seenaa addunyaatti beekkamu, jijjiirama qilleensaa hamaa ta’een miidhaa guddaa keessa jira. Bubbee hamaa fi rooba cimaa kanaan dura dhufeen lafti sigigaatee sirna bishaan obaafi lafa qonnaa waan miidheef, jireenyi qonnaan bultoota naannichaa balaa keessa galeera. Mootummaan deeggarsa gahaa gochuu waan hin dandeenyeef, bakki seena qabeessi kun balaa jijjiirama qilleensaa irraa of ittisuuf rakkachaa jira.

title: Tell killings: Does the right of self-defence apply only to Jews?
english: Four Palestinians and two Israelis were killed following a violent confrontation in the West Bank village of Tell after armed settlers entered the area. While Israeli authorities labeled the incident a terror attack, local witnesses and video footage suggest the settlers initiated the conflict. This event has raised significant questions about the actions of settlers in Palestinian territories and highlights the unequal application of self-defense justifications in the region.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ቴል መንደር በተፈጠረ የሁከት ግጭት አራት ፍልስጤማውያን እና ሁለት እስራኤላውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ክስተቱን የሽብር ጥቃት ሲሉት፣ የአይን እማኞች እና የተለቀቁ ምስሎች ግጭቱን የጀመሩት ታጣቂ ሰፋሪዎች መሆናቸውን ያሳያሉ። ይህ ክስተት በፍልስጤም ግዛቶች ውስጥ ሰፋሪዎች ስለሚፈጽሙት ድርጊት እና በክልሉ ስለሚታየው የራስን መከላከል መብት አጠቃቀም ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።

title: Pregnant Palestinian woman loses child after Israeli forces obstruct ambulance
english: A pregnant Palestinian woman lost her unborn child after Israeli soldiers blocked an ambulance from passing through a military checkpoint near Nablus. The medical team was forced to turn off their vehicle, causing essential life-saving equipment to stop working while the woman faced critical health complications. Additionally, officials reported that the soldiers delayed the transport by detaining a crew member and conducting a search during the emergency.

title: Lebanese army condemns ongoing Israeli 'attacks and violations'
english: The Lebanese military has criticized ongoing Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon, stating that these actions violate international laws and existing agreements. The army claims these operations are destroying infrastructure and hindering their ability to deploy forces effectively to the region. Consequently, these hostilities are preventing displaced citizens from safely returning to their homes.

title: Israeli forces storm homes in south Syria
english: Israeli military personnel conducted an operation in southern Syria's Daraa province early Monday morning. During this raid, soldiers searched multiple residential properties in the village of al-Ardah. The activity was reportedly accompanied by significant gunfire throughout the area.

title: Thousands march in Pakistan-administered Kashmir amid election unrest
english: Large crowds have marched in Pakistan-administered Kashmir to protest against governance issues and planned electoral changes. This unrest follows a violent period since June that has resulted in dozens of deaths and hundreds of injuries. Demonstrators are moving toward Muzaffarabad as tensions remain high ahead of the upcoming regional elections.

oromo: Godina Paakistaanin bulfamu kan Kaashmiir keessatti, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman rakkoo bulchiinsaa fi jijjiirama seera filannoo mormuuf hiriira ba'aniiru. title: Sudan’s army claims control of major highway linking Khartoum and el-Obeid
english: The Sudanese military has successfully recaptured the Al Sadarat highway, a vital supply route connecting Khartoum to the city of el-Obeid. By defeating the Rapid Support Forces after intense fighting, the army has secured a direct path to transport essential military supplies and aid. This strategic victory is expected to relieve the pressure on el-Obeid, where half a million people have been trapped under the paramilitary group's siege.

oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Sudaan karaa guddaa Kaartum fi magaalaa el-Obeid wal quunnisiisu guutumaatti to’annoo isaa jala oolchuu beeksiseera. Waraana cimaa booda humnoota 'Rapid Support Forces' injifachuun, raayyaan kun meeshaalee waraanaa fi gargaarsa namoomaa hatattamaan geejjibuuf karaa banateera. Injifannoon kun magaalaa el-Obeid keessatti namoota kuma dhibba shan ta’an kan turan irratti dhiibbaa jiru salphisuuf akkasumas gargaarsa barbaachisu dhaqqabsiisuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba.

title: Vendor’s livestream captures chaos as gunfire erupts at Seattle Center
english: A shooting incident occurred at the Bite of Seattle festival near the Space Needle, which was accidentally recorded by a vendor during a live broadcast. The violent event resulted in the deaths of at least two individuals. Additionally, five people were injured in the attack, including a two-year-old toddler.
amharic: በሲያትል ሴንተር በተካሄደው 'ባይት ኦፍ ሲያትል' ፌስቲቫል ላይ የተኩስ እሩምታ ተከስቷል፣ ይህም በአንድ ሻጭ የቀጥታ ስርጭት ወቅት በቪዲዮ ተቀድቷል። በዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ቢያንስ ሁለት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በተጨማሪም የአንድ ሁለት ዓመት ሕፃን ልጅን ጨምሮ አምስት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል።
oromo: Ayyaana 'Bite of Seattle' bakka jedhamutti dhukaasni banamee namoota hedduu biratti sodaafi jeequmsa uumeera; kunis namicha meeshaa gurguru tokkoo kan vidiyoon inni live godhaa ture irratti galfameera. Dhukaasa kanaan namoonni lama battalumatti du'aniiru. Kana malees, daa'ima waggaa lamaa dabalatee namoonni biroo shan madaa'aniiru.

title: Sudan’s army regains control of highway linking Khartoum with El Obeid
english: The Sudanese military has successfully recaptured the Al Sadarat highway, which serves as a vital route connecting the capital, Khartoum, to the city of El Obeid. El Obeid had previously been surrounded by forces from the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces. This development marks a significant shift in control over key infrastructure in the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር ከካርቱም ወደ ኤል ኦቤድ ከተማ የሚያገናኘውን አል ሳዳራት የተባለውን ዋና መንገድ በቁጥጥሩ ስር አውሏል። ኤል ኦቤድ ከተማ ከዚህ ቀደም በራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሰስ ታጣቂዎች ከበባ ውስጥ ትገኝ ነበር። ይህ የጦር ሰራዊቱ እንቅስቃሴ በሀገሪቱ በሚካሄደው ግጭት ውስጥ ቁልፍ የሆነ የመሰረተ ልማት መንገድን መልሶ ለመቆጣጠር ያስቻለ ትልቅ ለውጥ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Sudaan daandii guddicha Al Sadarat kan magaalaa Khartuum fi El Obeed wal qunnamsiisu to'annoo isaa jala oolcheera. Magaalaan El Obeed kanaan dura humnoota farra mootummaa kan 'Rapid Support Forces' jedhamaniin marsamtee turte. Tarkaanfiin kun lola biyyattii keessatti adeemaa jiru keessatti to'annoo bu'uuraaleealee misoomaa murteessoo ta'an irratti jijjiirama guddaa fida.

title: Russia and Ukraine trade attacks, killing 10, including child in Chernihiv
english: Russian and Ukrainian forces exchanged deadly aerial attacks over the weekend, resulting in the deaths of at least ten people. Russian missile and drone strikes across several Ukrainian cities hit residential areas and a supermarket, killing a young girl and several others. Meanwhile, officials in Russian-occupied territory reported that Ukrainian drone strikes resulted in four additional fatalities in the city of Horlivka.
amharic: የሩሲያ እና የዩክሬን ኃይሎች በሳምንቱ መጨረሻ ባደረጉት የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ አስር ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የሩሲያ ሚሳኤሎች እና ድሮኖች በበርካታ የዩክሬን ከተሞች ውስጥ በሚገኙ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች እና አንድ ሱፐርማርኬት ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት አንዲት ህጻን ልጅን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። በሌላ በኩል በሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የሆርሊቭካ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች መገደላቸውን የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoota Raashiyaa fi Yuukreyn gidduutti dhukaasni amba qilleensaa torban dhumaa keessa geggeeffame lubbuu namoota kudhanii galaafateera. Raashiyaan magaalota Yuukreyn keessatti iddoowwan namoonni jiraatan fi suuqii gurgurtaa irratti miisaa'elii fi doroniin miidhaa geessisteen intalli xinniittii tokko dabalatee namoonni hedduun ajjeefamaniiru. Gama biraatiin, magaalaa Hoorliivkaa kan Raashiyaan qabatte keessatti dhukaasa doonii Yuukreynin namoonni afur du'uu isaanii angawoonni Raashiyaa beeksisaniiru.

title: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has criticized New York official Zohran Mamdani for previously threatening to arrest him over alleged war crimes. Mamdani later admitted he lacks the legal authority to enforce an International Criminal Court warrant. Netanyahu accused the official of spreading division and hate, specifically noting rising safety concerns for Jewish residents in the city.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ፣ የኒውዮርክ ከተማ ባለስልጣን ዞህራን ማምዳኒ በእሳቸው ላይ የእስር ዛቻ በማድረጋቸው ተችተዋቸዋል። ማምዳኒ በኋላ ላይ ዓለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ላይ ባወጣው የቁጥጥር ትዕዛዝ መሰረት እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ህጋዊ ስልጣን እንደሌላቸው አምነዋል። ኔታንያሁ ባለስልጣኑ ጥላቻን በመዝራት ማህበረሰቡን ለመከፋፈል እየሞከሩ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuun, aangawaa magaalaa Niiwu Yoork Zohraan Maamdanii qabamuuf yaalii taasisaniin erga isaan qeeqanii booda, kun jibbiinsa kan facaasu ta'uu ibsan. Maamdaniin boodarratti aangoo seerawaa mana murtii yakka addunyaa raawwachuuf akka hin qabne beekanii jiru. Netanyaahuun aangawaan kun ummata gargar qooduuf jecha jibbiinsa kakaasaa jiraachuun himatanii jiru.

title: Guterres tours Syria’s notorious ‘Assad Prison’ in Sednaya
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres visited the Sednaya prison in Syria, marking the first time a UN chief has traveled to the country since 2009. This facility is widely recognized as a site of extreme brutality where the Syrian government has held, tortured, and killed many people. By touring this notorious location, the UN leader has brought renewed international attention to the severe human rights abuses committed within the regime's detention system.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሃፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በሶሪያ የሚገኘውን ሴድናያ እስር ቤት ጎብኝተዋል፤ ይህም እ.ኤ.አ. ከ2009 ወዲህ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን ወደ ሶሪያ ሲጓዙ የመጀመሪያው ነው። ይህ እስር ቤት የአሳድ መንግስት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ያሰቃየበት እና የገደለበት የጭካኔ ማዕከል በመባል ይታወቃል። ዋና ጸሃፊው ይህንን አስከፊ ቦታ መጎብኘታቸው በሶሪያ እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ለአለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ትኩረት እንዲሰጠው አድርጓል።
oromo: Garee mirkaneessaa tokkummaa mootummootaa Antonio Guterres mana hidhaa Sednaya kan biyya Sooriyaa keessatti argamu daawwataniiru. Kunis gorsaan tokkummaa mootummootaa waggaa 2009 booda yeroo jalqabaaf biyyattii daawwatu dha. Mana hidhaa kana keessatti mootummaan Sooriyaa namoota baay'ee dararaa fi ajjeesaa akka ture beekama. Daawwannaan kun yakka mirga namoomaa mana hidhaa san keessatti raawwatameef xiyyeeffannoo addunyaa akka deebi'u taasiseera.

title: Iran war live: Tehran halts retaliatory strikes after pause in US attacks
english: The United States has suspended its two-week bombing campaign against Iran, resulting in a corresponding halt to retaliatory strikes from Tehran. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump has publicly rejected claims that the military is experiencing shortages of ammunition. He asserted that the country maintains substantial stockpiles that are more than sufficient for current needs.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኢራን ላይ ሲያካሂድ የቆየውን የሁለት ሳምንት የቦምብ ጥቃት ያቆመ ሲሆን፣ በምላሹም የኢራን መንግስት በአካባቢው ሲፈጽም የነበረውን የአጸፋ ጥቃት አቁሟል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት እያለቀ መሆኑን የሚገልጹ ዘገባዎችን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የአገሪቱ የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት ለፍላጎቱ በቂ እና ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa duula gama xiyyaaraan irratti gaggeessaa ture dhaabuun isaa, mootummaan Iraanis tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu akka dhaabu taasiseera. Gamtaan biroo, pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp gabaasota humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa rasaasa dhabuu isaanii ibsan haalaniiru. Pirezidaantichi qabeenyi waraanaa biyyattii amma jiru kan gahaa fi baay'ee ta'uu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.
